title: a block-local binding is not visible after the block
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: The contract makes this an error without fixing the detection stage; static analysis may reject it, otherwise execution fails. Either way the program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.3: bindings declared inside the block do not leak outside; reading it is `Undefined variable`.
